```yaml
name: Electron E2E Tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  e2e:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '20'
        cache: 'pnpm'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pnpm install
      
    - name: Type check
      run: pnpm run typecheck
      
    - name: Build app
      run: pnpm run build
      
    - name: Run E2E tests
      run: pnpm run test:e2e
      
    - name: Upload test results
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: e2e-results-${{ matrix.os }}
        path: |
          playwright-report/
          test-results/
```
